observations.feature: Two adjacent populated longitudinal mating slots; no central unpopulated chamber row visible.
Two adjacent rows of rectangular termination chambers with bent leads; no intervening third chamber row.

comparisonSpecimen.exclusionBasis: TGL 29331/04 printed page 11 table 4: 304/404 have populated outer rows with an unpopulated central chamber row. The termination-side photograph directly shows adjacent populated chamber rows.

observations: Top view shows the housing exterior and bent leads, but not the complete termination-chamber face or mating face.
Underside joints have irregular solder fillets and specular highlights; their apparent bright centres are not independently identified drilled-hole centres.
Primary and comparison housings have compatible exterior form; this does not prove identical installed form.

nextDiscriminatingEvidence: Check whether another existing primary oblique view exposes termination chambers; use chamber population before dimensional fitting.
Constrain board-plane centres with independently visible lead entries or mounting features; do not use solder highlight centroids as metrology.
